_notes: Default YouTube API quota (10,000 units/day) allows ~4 uploads/day with thumbnail + captions + playlist. Raise max_uploads_per_run and add slots after Google grants a quota increase. Until the Google Cloud project passes YouTube's API audit, YouTube forces API uploads to private even when publishAt is set. max_uploads_per_day caps uploads in any rolling 24 h so the 3-hourly runs never exceed the daily quota.
